Predict optimal crop for soil & climate profile
post.description: Accepts Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium (NPK), Temperature, Humidity, pH, and Rainfall inputs and returns top recommended crops with confidence score and agronomic advisory.

post.summary: Predict crop yield and estimated revenue
post.description: Predicts yield in quintals per acre, total production, MSP financial revenue estimate, and agronomic risk assessment for given farm parameters.

post.summary: Get weather forecast and farming advisories
post.description: Fetches current weather, 5-day daily forecast, extreme weather risk alerts (heatwave, frost, heavy rainfall, high winds), and actionable agromet advisories.

get.summary: Get current weather by district and state parameters
Get weather advisory by location string

post.summary: Predict disease/pest from plant leaf image
Analyze crop leaf image for disease diagnosis and advisory
post.description: Upload a crop leaf image (.jpg, .png, .webp). Returns crop, condition type, diagnosis, confidence, and ordered evidence-based advisory.

post.summary: Analyze base64 encoded crop leaf image
Retrieve disease management advisory by crop & condition name

tags: Satellite Crop Health & NDVI Monitoring Engine
post.summary: Compute Sentinel-2 Satellite NDVI & Crop Canopy Health
post.description: Calculates Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) from Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite imagery for given farm coordinates.

post.summary: Chat with KrishiVaani Tool-Calling AI Assistant
post.description: Processes farmer queries in natural language, automatically triggers underlying ML models (crop rec, yield prediction, weather advisory, disease detection, satellite NDVI), and returns a formatted conversational reply with structured payloads.

post.summary: Chat with Agricultural AI Assistant
Translate farming text across Indian regional languages (Sarvam mayura:v1)
post.description: Translates advisory text between English, Hindi, Odia, Bengali, Punjabi, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, etc.

post.summary: Convert voice speech audio to text transcript (Sarvam saaras:v1)
post.description: Accepts base64 audio bytes of voice query and transcribes into text in regional language.

post.summary: Convert farming advisory text into voice audio speech (Sarvam bulbul:v1)
post.description: Synthesizes advisory text into spoken audio payload with natural Indian voices.

post.summary: Recommend Fertilizer
post.description:
Get ICAR-based fertilizer dose recommendation for your crop.
Returns Urea / DAP / MOP quantities per acre with application schedule.

get.description:
Get sowing, transplanting & harvesting windows for a crop in a given state.
Sourced from ICAR / State Agriculture Department bulletins.

Get crop rotation recommendations based on the previous crop, soil type, and state.
Returns ranked options with agronomic reasons and soil benefits.

post.summary: Query agricultural knowledge base
post.description: Semantically retrieves authoritative recommendations from ICAR, CIBRC, and State Agricultural Universities for pests, diseases, crop rotations, soil health, and safety.

post.summary: Generate 3-year crop rotation sequence and soil improvement plan
post.description: Creates a multi-year cropping sequence (Year 1, Year 2, Year 3) considering soil health, rotation rules, pest-break principles, and soil improvement guidelines.

post.summary: Calculate production cost, estimated revenue, and gross return
post.description: Deterministic operational cost calculation (Seeds, Fertilizer, Pesticides, Labour, Irrigation, Machinery, Transport, Other). Computes gross return = revenue - cost.

get.summary: Query live APMC Mandi trading prices vs Statutory MSP
get.description: Returns prevailing modal prices across APMC mandis in India, compared against CCEA statutory MSP benchmarks.
